summary: All four coverage checkpoints are satisfied. The 'kept kinds' loop (trigger + note) plus the step test still assert presence + correct emit. (2) FunnelCanvas.spec.ts: selecting the start node and asserting side-panel-delete absent is present and load-bearing. (3) The new 'Delete/Backspace on a selected START node do NOT trigger the delete flow' test dispatches both keys with no editable focus; asserting the warning stays absent is load-bearing — removing the kind guard in onKeydown would arm the warning. (4) The confirmDelete(start) branch is still exercised at line 494-496 via the exposed requestDelete/confirmDelete methods, so the underlying delete logic for start remains covered even though the UI affords no button — this is the correct approach. No coverage was weakened for step/trigger/note kinds.
